brief player introduction. == Information == {{Player-info | realname = James Matthews | birthyear = 1980 | birthmonth = | birthday = | nationality = British | shortnationality = UK | currentclan = Retired - But can be lured out | clannationality = UK | adminof = | aka = | foundquake = 1996 | retired = 2005 | color1 = 4 | color2 = 3 | favmap = [[dm3]] }} Trivia: Started playing with demo version back in '96 when it was on a cover CD. Played it online and got me hooked on the internet and spent silly amounts on the phone bills (well my mum's money!) ;P Got me hooked on the internet and it takes me back to the days of 200-300 ping was quite playable and the odd modem cable sign appearing was normal. On great servers like wildnet and minos when they were filled with crazyed keyboard a few mouse-wielding LPB's. Joined and played with the wonderful CTF clan The Buddha finger - HanDoJin Paz Splitter (many more when I can remember!). The grappling hook was my favorite weapon! Joined O$ and if I find any timedemo's I'll tell you who they were! It was THAT long ago. Joined [MoD] to play Clan Arena, my 2nd love of Quake. Greets to the wonderful team - Reverend & Creamylust
Joined ]MB[ afterwards with what was left, which was great, Tronus organized a few wonderful clan meetings and that was really the last time I've properly played. Around 2005 I think. But still want to meet up so don't hesitate to shot me an email :) Other games: Never really enjoyed them as much, played CoD:MW2 and got pretty good, but it's not the same... At all. == Clan history == * [[Image:flag_q.gif]] Mad Bastards [MB] * [[Image:flag_q.gif]] Ministry of Death [MoD] * [[Image:flag_q.gif]] O$ * [[Image:flag_q.gif]] The Buddha Finger [TBF] == Achievements == == Quotes == Number 1 fan of the Italian plumbers - Logan and Hulk. == External links == {{chtv}} {{player-stub}} [[Category:Players]] [[Category:British Players]] __NOTOC__
